coverageNotes: Recognizes the documented Convex boundary under supplied conditions. Does not establish independent implementation skill or all source requirements.

questions.question: Which file layout lets both functions deploy and run?

options.rationale: A use node directive in an imported helper does not make the action's own module a Node module. The default-runtime action still imports Node built-ins transitively and fails bundling.
A module marked use node cannot export a Convex query. The health query must live in a default-runtime module.
The directive belongs at the module level. Placing use node inside the action handler does not select the Node runtime.
The action's module selects Node at the top level; the query remains in a separate default-runtime module.
